# Rebel 3.x

`FDOS/` contains the original package from
[`clasqm/freedos-repo`](https://github.com/clasqm/freedos-repo/blob/master/zip/rebel.zip).
Its `README.1ST` explicitly permits use, copying, and distribution without a
license or registration fee on an IBM PC-compatible with 384 KiB RAM and DOS
2.1 or later.
